every_position_composed.reason: Both sites share the same overlap in frame 5, but site 1 gives clean, unobstructed 3D transition views in frames 4 and 7 whereas site 2 shows an awkward near-invisible faded card in frame 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D press, anchor rack, and seven-lane gate machinery across frames 1 to 9 to visually trace how logs are compressed and routed.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D models, lighting, shadows, and grid floor across all 9 frames.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 avoids the unreadable low-contrast card fade seen in frame 7 of site 2 while keeping crisp typography across frames 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, and 9.

overall.reason: While the two sites are nearly identical variants of the same build, site 1 handles scroll transitions cleanly in frames 4 and 7 without leaving illegible faded text on screen like site 2 does in frame 7.
